title: Affine Spherical Mass and a Gaussian Kinematic Formula for Tropical Two-Fans
summary: Let $F$ be an effective balanced rational two-dimensional fan in a rank-four lattice. We introduce an affine spherical mass \[ M_*(F)=\inf_{covol_g(N)=1}M_g(F) \] and prove the two-sided comparison \[ \sqrt{\frac83}\,m(F)\leq M_*(F)\leq 3\sqrt{2\,q(F)}. \] Here $q(F)=deg(F\cdot F)$ is stable self-intersection and $m(F)$ is the least degree of $F$ under a primitive rank-two lattice quotient.
